beats.text: Strip the cover off your report. [Who wrote page 12?]
Partners approve logos on mock-ups. Buyers meet them on [working documents].
Ask every designer for [the same proof sheet].
A proposal cover. A crowded slide. [A chart with a source line.]
If the name disappears at real sizes, [it isn't finished].
Before buying a new logo, [fix the templates].

end.title: Test the logo where [buyers meet it].
